name: Lake
overview: The biblical concept of the 'lake' in Scripture, particularly the 'lake of fire,' represents the ultimate place of eternal judgment and separation from God. It is described as a burning lake of fire and brimstone where the beast, the false prophet, the devil, and all who are not found in the book of life are cast, experiencing everlasting torment. This lake is also identified as the 'second death,' reserved for the fearful, unbelieving, and those who practice sin and idolatry, emphasizing the finality and severity of God's righteous judgment.
